title: fix(studio): OWD overview confirms the controlled-by-parent prerequisite on a 409 DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu76CdcjMmgYPLs3UuMF1RMq)_

Fixes #27458
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：Studio 记录共享（OWD）总览里把对象设为「受父级控制」保存时，若服务器以 409 `DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE` 拒收，面板弹出确认框，点名将被设为必填的主从关系（`字段 → 主对象`）及服务器的说明；确认即带 `force` 重发同一保存，取消则什么都不存。
- 为什么改：此前该 409 只变成一条错误横幅，面板没有任何前进的路，提供的选项根本存不下来。
- 风险与回滚：仅改前端一个面板的保存路径，服务器守卫不动；`force` 只在作者确认后、且只加在带主从必填翻转的行上。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`PackageOwdOverviewPanel.tsx` 中 `doSave` 的 catch 分支与新确认框；其次新测试文件；最后 en/zh 文案。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/PackageOwdOverviewPanel.cbpPrerequisiteConfirm-27458.test.tsx`，预期 4 passed。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes
- `PackageOwdOverviewPanel` `doSave(force = false)`: for a row switched to `controlled_by_parent`, the save records which `master_detail` fields it makes required (`cbpPrerequisite`, `field → master`). When that save is answered `409` with `errorCodeIs(e, 'DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE')`, the panel opens a confirm (the existing shared `Dialog` from `@object-ui/components`, the same shape `PermissionMatrixEditor` uses; no new dialog component) naming the relationship and listing the server's issue messages. No error banner is set.
- Confirm retries the same save with `force: true`, only on rows that carry the prerequisite. Cancel closes the confirm; nothing is forced, the row stays Unsaved.
- Any other refusal (including a `DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE` on a row with no master-detail flip) keeps the existing `formatMetadataError` banner.
- The server's guard is untouched (triage: the 409 stands).
- Copy: `engine.studio.owd.cbpPrereqTitle` / `cbpPrereqDesc` / `cbpPrereqConfirm` in the studio namespace (en, zh).

## Tests
New `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.cbpPrerequisiteConfirm-27458.test.tsx`, four cases: the 409 opens the confirm naming `project → qnine_project` and the guard's message with no banner; confirm retries with `force` and the same body (`required: true` on the master-detail); cancel saves nothing and leaves the row Unsaved; a 422 still shows the error and opens no confirm.

- All OWD panel tests: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/PackageOwdOverviewPanel` -> Test Files 9 passed (9), Tests 40 passed (40).
- Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor = the confirm branch's `if` condition replaced by `if (false) {`, anchor 1 -> 0, blob 8ea5726e660c -> dac064a26bd7): the 27458 file goes 3 failed | 1 passed (the three confirm legs red, the non-destructive leg green); restored, blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check` -> exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/i18n/` -> 89 files passed, 1374 tests passed.
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 34 derived commands, all exit 0 (incl. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` 169 files passed); `--ran` reconciliation 34/34, 0 NOT-MEASURED. `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations` -> 0 new citations.
</details>

## Acceptance notes
- In a multi-row save the rows are written in order; rows written before the refused one are already saved as drafts when the confirm opens, and confirming re-saves them unchanged. Cancelling leaves those earlier drafts in place (they were not destructive). Single-row behaviour is exactly as the card asks.

## Verification
Local subset above; CI owns the full farm.
